source: can you make a game of you snipe zombies on the head. so they are standing still on a platform and you are higher and you have to snipe there heads off. it's kinda like practice

answers.ask: No look was stated - should the range read as a clean modern training facility, or as a grim outdoor zombie-apocalypse site?
answers.answer: Make it a grim outdoor zombie-apocalypse shooting range, with the zombies standing still on a platform below the player.

answers.ask: Is this scored (time, accuracy, headshot count) or purely free practice with no end condition?
answers.answer: Make it free practice with no end condition; the point is just practicing sniping zombie heads.

answers.ask: How far should the shot be - a short 100-stud range, or a long-distance one several hundred studs out?
answers.answer: Use a short 100-stud range so it stays simple and plainly playable as practice.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: No look was stated - should the range read as a clean modern training facility, or as a grim outdoor zombie-apocalypse site? A: Make it a grim outdoor zombie-apocalypse shooting range, with the zombies standing still on a platform below the player.
- [author] goal — Q: Is this scored (time, accuracy, headshot count) or purely free practice with no end condition? A: Make it free practice with no end condition; the point is just practicing sniping zombie heads.
- [author] scale — Q: How far should the shot be - a short 100-stud range, or a long-distance one several hundred studs out? A: Use a short 100-stud range so it stays simple and plainly playable as practice.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a grim outdoor zombie-apocalypse sniper practice range. Place the player’s firing platform on raised ground, facing straight downrange toward a lower target platform exactly 100 studs away. Arrange stationary zombie targets on the lower platform with their heads clearly exposed from the elevated firing angle. Keep the entire shooting corridor open and unobstructed, with a safe backdrop behind the zombies and no opposing route, moving enemies, scoring arena, or extra combat structures.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Shooter, specifically an Aim Trainer. The zombies are stationary practice targets rather than hostile survival actors, and the author explicitly requests free practice with no end condition.

## Shape and preset
Use `range-directed`: one elevated firing position faces downrange into a lower target field, with everything shootable in front of the player and no path through the course. Match the Aim Trainer preset, retaining its practice targets while dropping the weapon bench because only sniping practice is requested.

## Config requirements
Use `target-practice` for the stationary zombie figures arranged on the lower platform as headshot targets at the stated range. No cover, opposing base, lane network, loadout station, loot, or interior is requested. The raised firing and lower target platforms are scene-specific visible geometry.

## Layout requirements
Place the layout half of `target-practice` on the lower platform exactly 100 studs downrange, with all target heads visible from the firing platform; the author supplied no target count, so do not invent one. Add one free-text `SpawnZone` on the raised firing platform, oriented toward the targets. No scoring, finish, enemy-wave, or moving-target trigger is required.

## Layout components
Build one directed outdoor range containing a raised firing platform, a straight 100-stud open shooting corridor, one lower zombie-target platform, and a safe terminal backstop. Bound the sides so players remain behind the firing line without obstructing sightlines. Compose the two elevation levels and full shot distance clearly in one frame.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: the firing angle, grim atmosphere, and readable target silhouettes lead, while the straight range has no complex topology.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use medium scale because the exact 100-stud shot falls in the block band while individual zombie heads must remain legible. The theme is a grim outdoor zombie-apocalypse practice site. Use `tiered` for the non-overhanging raised firing platform above the lower target platform; no other modifier is needed.
